description: This file defines the CacheableResponsePlugin class, which integrates with Workbox to manage cacheability conditions based on response status codes and headers. It imports dependencies from related modules and exports the class for use in other parts of the service worker setup.

classes.name: CacheableResponsePlugin
classes.description: A class that implements the cacheWillUpdate lifecycle callback for Workbox strategies, enabling cacheability checks based on response status and headers.

methods.name: constructor(config)
methods.description: Initializes the CacheableResponsePlugin with provided configuration, setting up the cacheWillUpdate method and internal cacheable response checker.

methods.name: cacheWillUpdate
methods.description: Asynchronous method invoked during caching, which checks if the response is cacheable according to the specified status codes and headers, returning the response if so, or null otherwise.
